narrative council rows DIRECT; richer runLoanCouncil output (verdicts, AA codes, weighted aggregate) needs a declared-lineage mapping
integrity first-failure derivable from verifyBundle {seq,reason,impact}; business first-failure MISSING from Core; never synthesized
chain-break cascade (seq N breaks N..end) derivable; business consequences MISSING
bundle events with seq/prev_hash/payload_hash; payload CONTENTS are off-chain and SECURITY_SENSITIVE + PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED to include
citation_registry + citation_registry_sha256 exist on the loan-council/attestation path; flow export carries only cites relationships
human_approval event + reviewer_interaction payload exist; reviewer_id/override_rationale are PII; payload-level checks need --payloads
event presence checkable via banking-v1 profile; no approval-state field exists (by design)
verifier output trustLevel only; never stored in a bundle; ship only in the derived verification member
payload_hash/prev_hash/batch_root portable; web displays format-checked only
single Ed25519 bundle signature; verifyBundle reads signatures[0] only; attestation signature separate
SPKI PEM + opaque key_id; embed as member + full-length fingerprint in manifest; identity trust remains out-of-band; revocation ABSENT
ship as reproducible view; consumers re-derive; disagreement is a first-class display state; never evidence
header.models[] + sampling_params_hash + prompt_sha256 DIRECT; tool VERSION fields MISSING (names only)
authored labels only; DEVICE_VALIDATED/PRODUCTION_READY hard-error in web contract; physical claims never ride a package
bilingual verification-report.{en,zh-CN}.json precedent exists; flow export monolingual (web adapter writes en=zh)

business first-failure/downstream MISSING from Core; display models exist only web-side
